title: Negation
subtitle: Ne + verb, often reinforced — double negatives are emphatic.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Ne + verb, often reinforced with nat or noght. He ne dorste nat (he dared not). Double and triple negatives are emphatic, not incorrect. Chaucer: 'He nevere yet no vileynye ne sayde / In all his lyf unto no maner wight' — five negatives for emphasis.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.
